mapper.select: SELECT role_code AS "roleCode", role_name AS "roleName", purpose, assignment_criteria AS "assignmentCriteria", default_data_scope AS "defaultDataScope", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM role role_code=#{f.roleCode} ORDER BY role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (role_code, role_name, purpose, assignment_criteria, default_data_scope, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{body.roleCode}, #{body.roleName}, #{body.purpose}, #{body.assignmentCriteria}, #{body.defaultDataScope}, COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, 'Y'), now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name=COALESCE(#{body.roleName}, role_name), purpose=COALESCE(#{body.purpose}, purpose), assignment_criteria=COALESCE(#{body.assignmentCriteria}, assignment_criteria), default_data_scope=COALESCE(#{body.defaultDataScope}, default_data_scope), use_yn=COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT assignment_id AS "assignmentId", user_id AS "userId", role_code AS "roleCode", assignment_type AS "assignmentType", approved_by AS "approvedBy", effective_start_date AS "effectiveStartDate", effective_end_date AS "effectiveEndDate", status, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM user_role user_id=#{f.userId}AND role_code=#{f.roleCode} ORDER BY assignment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_code, assignment_type, approved_by, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{body.userId}, #{body.roleCode}, 'MANUAL', #{approvedBy}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{body.effectiveStartDate}, '')::date, CURRENT_DATE), NULLIF(#{body.effectiveEndDate}, '')::date, 'ACTIVE', 'Y', now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_role SET approved_by=COALESCE(#{body.approvedBy}, approved_by), effective_start_date=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{body.effectiveStartDate}, '')::date, effective_start_date), effective_end_date=NULLIF(#{body.effectiveEndDate}, '')::date, updated_at=now() WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND assignment_type='MANUAL'
UPDATE user_role SET status='REVOKED', use_yn='N', updated_at=now() WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND assignment_type='MANUAL'
mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", parent_menu_id AS "parentMenuId", menu_type AS "menuType", menu_name AS "menuName", screen_id AS "screenId", url, icon, business_category AS "businessCategory", description, display_order AS "displayOrder", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{f.menuName}, '%') ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_menu_id, ''), display_order

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id AS "menuId", m.parent_menu_id AS "parentMenuId", m.menu_type AS "menuType", m.menu_name AS "menuName", m.screen_id AS "screenId", m.url, m.icon, m.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM menu m JOIN menu_permission p ON p.menu_id=m.menu_id JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_code=p.target_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND p.target_type='ROLE' AND p.decision='ALLOW' AND p.use_yn='Y' AND m.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY m.display_order
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
UPDATE menu SET display_order=#{displayOrder}, updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_type, menu_name, screen_id, url, icon, business_category, description, display_order, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{body.menuId}, #{body.parentMenuId}, COALESCE(#{body.menuType}, 'SCREEN'), #{body.menuName}, #{body.screenId}, #{body.url}, #{body.icon}, #{body.businessCategory}, #{body.description}, COALESCE(#{body.displayOrder}, 99), COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, 'Y'), now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET menu_name=COALESCE(#{body.menuName}, menu_name), screen_id=COALESCE(#{body.screenId}, screen_id), url=COALESCE(#{body.url}, url), icon=COALESCE(#{body.icon}, icon), business_category=COALESCE(#{body.businessCategory}, business_category), description=COALESCE(#{body.description}, description), use_yn=COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT permission_id AS "permissionId", target_type AS "targetType", target_id AS "targetId", menu_id AS "menuId", decision, api_path_pattern AS "apiPathPattern", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu_permission target_type=#{f.targetType}AND target_id=#{f.targetId} ORDER BY target_type, target_id, menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_permission (target_type, target_id, menu_id, decision, api_path_pattern, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{body.targetType}, #{body.targetId}, #{body.menuId}, #{body.decision}, #{body.apiPathPattern}, 'Y', now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (target_type, target_id, menu_id) DO UPDATE SET decision=EXCLUDED.decision, api_path_pattern=EXCLUDED.api_path_pattern, updated_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT group_id AS "groupId", group_name AS "groupName", description, managing_department AS "managingDepartment", status, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM code_group group_id=#{f.groupId} ORDER BY group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_group (group_id, group_name, description, managing_department, status, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{body.groupId}, #{body.groupName}, #{body.description}, #{body.managingDepartment}, COALESCE(#{body.status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, 'Y'), now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE code_group SET group_name=COALESCE(#{body.groupName}, group_name), description=COALESCE(#{body.description}, description), managing_department=COALESCE(#{body.managingDepartment}, managing_department), status=COALESCE(#{body.status}, status), use_yn=COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT group_id AS "groupId", code_value AS "codeValue", code_name AS "codeName", parent_code_value AS "parentCodeValue", display_order AS "displayOrder", additional_attributes AS "additionalAttributes", effective_start_date AS "effectiveStartDate", effective_end_date AS "effectiveEndDate", status, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM detail_code WHERE group_id=#{groupId} ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detail_code (group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_code_value, display_order, additional_attributes, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status, use_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{body.codeValue}, #{body.codeName}, #{body.parentCodeValue}, COALESCE(#{body.displayOrder}, 99), CAST(COALESCE(#{body.additionalAttributes}, '{}') AS jsonb), NULLIF(#{body.effectiveStartDate}, '')::date, NULLIF(#{body.effectiveEndDate}, '')::date, COALESCE(#{body.status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, 'Y'), now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE detail_code SET code_name=COALESCE(#{body.codeName}, code_name), parent_code_value=COALESCE(#{body.parentCodeValue}, parent_code_value), display_order=COALESCE(#{body.displayOrder}, display_order), status=COALESCE(#{body.status}, status), use_yn=COALESCE(#{body.useYn}, use_yn), updated_at=now() WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND code_value=#{codeValue}
